agreement.name: Religious Studies B.A. Online Degree Completion

notes.content: See the Professional & Continuing Education website for more information about this program and to start the application process. See the University Catalog for prerequisite information and upper division program requirements . See the Admissions website for transfer admission requirements/information. See the International Education & Global Engagement website for international transfer academic qualifications. See the Academic Advising Programs website for information on California Promise and Associate Degree for Transfer. See the University Catalog for Credit by Exam information (AP, IB, CLEP). Online degree completion students who have completed their General Education and American Ideals/Institutions requirements before transferring to Chico State and who enroll in classes full time can easily finish their BA in social science in two years. Note that some online courses are offered only once a year, so careful planning is crucial. All students must meet with a Social Science advisor each semester for mandatory advising.

Online degree completion students who have completed their General Education and American Ideals/Institutions requirements before transferring to Chico State and who enroll in classes full time can easily finish their BA in social science in two years. Note that some online courses are offered only once a year, so careful planning is crucial. All students must meet with a Social Science advisor each semester for mandatory advising.
